description: LumberChunker on SQuAD and ConditionalQA, segmented by mistral-small-3-2-24b-instruct-2506, the other stages at the README's baseline: no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. It calls the LLM over a growing window of paragraphs for every boundary, so it is limited by the endpoint's 128,000 input tokens a minute and kept to the two smallest datasets. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/lumberchunker_eval.json

chunk_embedding.description: Over-long chunks (LumberChunker has no upper bound) are cut to bge-m3's limit, counted with its own tokenizer.
